name: fast-profile01
derivation: Ceiling of each original frozen repetition count divided by eight; four warmups for every role. Chosen before new program timing; no source or workload-argument change.
scope: Separately labeled short-batch screening profile. Same exact wrapper, workload arguments, expected output and selected counts across all compared roles. Counts and 20ms qualification threshold differ from original Phase93 profile; do not merge timing observations or aggregates. One-millisecond clock resolution makes small percentage gains inconclusive.
